procedural_matters: The Technical Committee was represented by Zoran Grubisa (chairman of the technical committee).
HUN 53 -Chocolate 3- was represented by Peter Czegai (helm)
Henrik Hoffmann (trimmer) attended the hearing as interpreter for HUN 53.
Zoran Grubisa was not present when the decision was given.
facts: HUN 53 -Chocolate 3- was selected for a post-race equipment inspection on the water after race #2 (1st inshore race).
At the time of the inspection HUN 53 -Chocolate 3- did not have a heavy weather jib nor a trysail (or a mainsail reefing to reduce the luff by at least 40%) on board.
HUN 53 -Chocolate 3- stated that there was a misunderstanding by the team which sails they shall have on board.
conclusions: HUN 53 failed to comply with OSR 4.26.3 by not having on board a storm trysail or mainsail reefing to reduce the luff by at least 40%.
HUN 53 failed to comply with OSR 4.26.5 by not having on board a heavy weather jib.
decision: Using the World Sailing Discretionary Penalty Guidelines for Boats & Support Persons a starting penalty of DSQ (band 4) was decided as the breach concerns safety equipment.
There were no circumstances to justify decreasing the penalty to a lower band.
There were no circumstances to justify increasing the penalty.
